strategies.instructions: Explicitly choose the Slack-hosted MCP setup route. Read this version's SUPPORT.md and provider registration instructions. The documented endpoint is https://mcp.slack.com/mcp using Streamable HTTP, with a fixed eligible Slack app and user OAuth; dynamic client registration is unavailable. Obtain current tool schemas and bind only selected operations through the existing host owners. Report denial or missing prerequisites; do not switch to REST automatically.

strategies.instructions: Explicitly choose the local Python or TypeScript SlackOperations library and exact verified artifact in SUPPORT.md. Both provide five one-request operations: auth.test, conversations.list, conversations.info, conversations.history and conversations.replies. Python methods are auth_test, list_conversations_page, get_conversation, history_page and replies_page. TypeScript methods are authTest, listConversationsPage, getConversation, historyPage and repliesPage. The existing host supplies the selected credential, API base, account/resource authority and transport lifetime. Compare auth_test/authTest team_id and user_id against independently selected host identity; a supplied team selector is not identity proof. The agent chooses conversation types, explicit pages, exact conversation IDs, interval and thread coverage. Preserve cursors, timestamps and unknown fields. Perform a policy-permitted selected-resource read before requesting the existing owner to attest that operation binding. Report mismatch, missing access, unsupported response, rate limit or unavailable data to that owner; never repair identity by switching credentials. Publish only after existing host activation/authentication owners bind the selected operations. This does not create a frontend, grant, complete weekly report or automatic fallback from MCP.
unresolved_details: Python source and a private wheel, and TypeScript source and a private npm archive, have bounded installed proof. Neither package is claimed publicly released. Select exact bytes; package version 0.1.0 alone does not identify this revision.

The existing credential owner must supply registration, human authorization when needed, token lifecycle and independently selected account/resource binding. No credential belongs in agent-visible recipe fields.

Explicit discovery pages are implemented; automatic name/intent resolution, pagination, thread expansion, message search/send and complete date-range retrieval are not implemented by these operations.
